findings.issue: Cache key mismatch: saveCommunityCache writes {fetchedAt, data} but session-context.js reads cache.knowledge and cache.lastSync. Community knowledge is permanently non-functional.
findings.recommendation: Change cache.knowledge to cache.data, cache.lastSync to cache.fetchedAt

findings.issue: No HTTPS protocol enforcement in httpsRequest(). Config serverUrl accepting http:// enables SSRF via internal/metadata endpoints.
findings.recommendation: Add protocol check: if (parsed.protocol !== 'https:') reject. Add validateServerUrl() that rejects private IPs and metadata endpoints.

findings.issue: GIT_USER_PATTERN uses non-capturing group (?:Author|Committer) but replacement references $1. Emits literal '$1: [REDACTED]' instead of 'Author: [REDACTED]'. PII stripping correctness bug.
findings.recommendation: Change to capturing group: /(Author|Committer):\s*[^\n<]+/g or use fixed replacement string.

findings.issue: Unsafe deserialization of server response via raw JSON.parse with no size limit, no schema validation, no prototype pollution check. Malicious server can inject arbitrary data into AI context.
findings.recommendation: Use safeJsonParseString, add 2MB response body size cap, validate structure before caching.

findings.issue: UNIX_PATH_PATTERN only matches hardcoded prefixes (Users, home, var, etc). Paths under /srv/, /data/, /mnt/, /workspace/, /Volumes/ pass through PII stripping unredacted.
findings.recommendation: Broaden to catch any absolute path or add missing prefixes.

findings.issue: submitSuggestion returns Promise<boolean> but wogi-suggest.md checks result.queued. Offline-queued confirmation path is permanently unreachable.
findings.recommendation: Change submitSuggestion to return {success, queued} object or fix command to check boolean.

findings.issue: 5 raw JSON.parse calls (lines 281, 579, 651, 681, 725) violate security-patterns.md Rule #2. safeJsonParse is imported but unused. Prototype pollution risk.
findings.recommendation: Replace with safeJsonParse for file reads. Add safeJsonParseString for HTTP response body.

findings.issue: Double PII stripping: collectShareableData already strips internally, then wogi-session-end strips again. anonId added by both caller and pushToServer.
findings.recommendation: Remove redundant stripPII call and anonId from session-end snippet.

findings.issue: retryPendingSuggestions uses indexOf-based slice with reference equality hazard. Early abort on any exception skips remaining suggestions.
findings.recommendation: Use numeric index loop with pending.slice(i) on error.

findings.issue: ~/.wogiflow/ created without restrictive permissions. Default umask gives 755 (world-readable). Contains anon-id and pending suggestions.
findings.recommendation: Use mode 0o700 for directory and 0o600 for sensitive files.

findings.issue: submitSuggestion sends raw text without PII stripping despite stated privacy invariant.
findings.recommendation: Add stripPIIFromString(text, config.projectName) before building suggestion object.

findings.issue: Unbounded response body accumulation. No size cap on data += chunk. Slow-streaming server can cause memory exhaustion.
collectModelIntelligence and collectSkillLearnings send up to 500 chars from user-authored .md files. Code fences and uncovered paths can leak.
findings.recommendation: Strip code fences before truncating. Apply broadened path regex.

findings.issue: SSRF via URL construction. serverUrl concatenated without path/query/fragment validation.
findings.recommendation: Add validateServerUrl() that asserts clean base URL (protocol=https, empty path/search/hash).

findings.issue: function-map.md documents submitSuggestion return type as Object but actual is Promise<boolean>.
findings.recommendation: Update function-map.md to match actual signature.

findings.issue: Dead config key anonymousId: null. Never read by flow-community.js. Contradicts privacy design.
findings.recommendation: Remove from config.json, installer.js, and config.schema.json.

findings.issue: TOCTOU race on anon-id creation. Concurrent processes can generate different UUIDs.
findings.recommendation: Use exclusive write flag: { flag: 'wx' }. On EEXIST, re-read.

findings.issue: Module-level /g regex constants are shared mutable state. Safe with .replace() but fragile if .test()/.exec() used.
findings.recommendation: Move regex inside stripPIIFromString() or add warning comment.

findings.issue: WINDOWS_PATH_PATTERN has redundant i flag with [A-Z] character class.
findings.recommendation: Use [A-Za-z] without i flag for clarity.
